about: By-election causes (and the outgoing member) from Wikipedia's lists of by-elections, for contests whose files record no cause. Read by scripts/build-test2-election-manifest.mjs, which fills the contest's cause only where it is empty, so the result panel shows it as "Cause". Facts and citations only; extracted 2026-10-13 against the revisions given.
